about_image_alt: Pantry shelves stocked with canned goods, pasta and rice, each shelf labeled
kicker: A neighborhood food pantry in Millbrook
hero_title: Good food for every table in Millbrook.
hero_sub: Free groceries three days a week, with no paperwork and no questions about why. Run by neighbors, for neighbors.
mission: No one in Millbrook should have to choose between groceries and the electric bill.
about: Harvest Table started in a church basement in 2009 with two shelves of canned goods. Today it is a small grocery-style pantry where families choose their own food.
Volunteers and local donors stock every shelf. Most of the food comes from area farms, grocery stores and community food drives.
services_intro: Every program is free. If you are not sure which one fits, ask at the front desk.

services.name: Weekly pantry
services.text: Choose your own groceries on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays, like a small grocery store.

services.name: Weekend backpacks
services.text: Kid-friendly food sent home from two Millbrook elementary schools every Friday.

services.name: Senior delivery
services.text: Groceries brought to the door for neighbors over 65 who cannot get out.

services.name: Garden share
services.text: Fresh vegetables from our community garden, June through October.

donate_text: Your gift buys food from our regional food bank and keeps the lights on at the pantry.
volunteer_text: Sort donations, stock shelves or drive a senior delivery route. Shifts are two hours.
ask_text: Just come in during open hours. If you cannot get here, call and ask about senior delivery.
contact_text: Questions about programs, donations or volunteering. We answer within two days.
